title: Dropping Off Clothes at a Dry Cleaner
context: Lena 把一件沾了红酒渍的外套送到干洗店，向店员 Chris 询问能否去渍、取件时间和价格。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Hi. I'd like to drop off this coat for dry cleaning.
dialogue.zh: 你好。我想把这件外套送去干洗。

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.en: Sure. Is there a stain you'd like us to treat?
dialogue.zh: 没问题。有什么污渍需要我们处理吗？

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Yes, there's a red wine stain on the right sleeve.
dialogue.zh: 有的，右袖上有一块红酒渍。

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.en: Got it. We'll pretreat the stain before we clean the coat.
dialogue.zh: 明白了。我们会先预处理污渍，再干洗这件外套。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Great. How long will it usually take?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。一般要多久能取？

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.en: Regular service is two days. Same-day pickup is available until three.
dialogue.zh: 普通服务两天。当天取件可以，最晚三点前。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Two days is fine. Do I need to leave a phone number?
dialogue.zh: 两天可以。需要留电话号码吗？

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.en: Yes, please. We'll text you when it's ready for pickup.
dialogue.zh: 需要。衣服好了我们会发短信通知你来取。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Okay. How much will the coat cost?
dialogue.zh: 好。这件外套大概多少钱？

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Perfect. Can I pay when I pick it up?
dialogue.zh: 很好。我可以取件的时候再付款吗？

dialogue.speaker: Chris
dialogue.en: Of course. Here's your claim ticket. See you in two days!
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。这是您的取件单。两天后见！

expressions.zh: 送去干洗。把衣物交给干洗店时常用。
expressions.example: I'd like to drop off this coat for dry cleaning.

expressions.zh: 处理污渍。去渍、预处理时常用。
expressions.example: Can you treat the red wine stain on the sleeve?

expressions.zh: 当天取件。加急服务常用说法。
expressions.example: Is same-day pickup available for this dress?

expressions.zh: 可以取件了。店家通知顾客时常用。
expressions.example: We'll text you when it's ready for pickup.

expressions.zh: 取件单/取衣凭条。取衣服时出示。
expressions.example: Please bring your claim ticket when you pick it up.

pronunciation: 练习 dry cleaning 的节奏：DRY CLEANing。注意 stain 的长元音 /steɪn/，pretreat 重音在后：pre-TREAT，以及 claim ticket 的清晰爆破音：CLAIM TICket。

practice.title: Part 1 · Clothes and cleaning
practice.prompt: Do you usually wash clothes at home, or do you use a laundry or dry cleaner?
practice.answer: I wash most clothes at home. For coats and formal clothes, I sometimes use a dry cleaner, especially if there is a stain.

practice.title: Part 2 · A time you cleaned something carefully
practice.prompt: Describe a time you took something to be cleaned. Say what it was, why it needed cleaning, and what happened.
practice.answer: Last month I took my coat to a dry cleaner because of a wine stain. They pretreated it and I picked it up two days later. I was relieved it looked almost new. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Services in daily life
practice.prompt: Why do some people prefer professional cleaning services instead of washing everything at home?
practice.answer: Professional cleaners can remove difficult stains and care for delicate fabrics. They also save time for busy people. However, the service costs more than washing at home.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读。最后练习说明衣服上的污渍、需要几天取件，以及是否当天取件。
practice.answer: 用 3–4 句说明你会怎么送一件衣服去干洗：污渍、服务时效、价格和取件方式。
